1972.finding: The narrow 72 year is independently reconstructed from the 926403 and 910938 photographs. Its authored proportions fit naturally at the requested cap height; uniform-height overlays preserve the remaining scan uncertainty.
1972.fontEvidence: Only the observed 7 and 2 are reconstructed. Smooth authored geometry and advances are supported by two specimens and compared against 60 named candidate profiles; no horizontal font scaling or historical typeface identification. See docs/research/bc-decal-corrections/annual-1972/.

1986.finding: Rounded P/R bowls are reconstructed from MAR, APR and SEP. Transparent overlap artifacts are removed from R/T/V. P/R have new authored advances; the other observed glyph advances are retained, with explicit AR/PR pair placement. The supplied EXPO composition is retained after twelve-source review.
1986.fontEvidence: All twelve selected month names were reviewed. M/A retain the prior geometric construction; P/R have new constructions; T/V retain native contours painted additively; other observed capitals retain documented candidates. Exact historical font identity and printed EXPO weight remain uncertain. See docs/research/bc-decal-corrections/expo86/.

1999.fontEvidence: MAY alone uses independently authored M/A/Y contours and advances with explicit AY pair spacing. Other months retain their prior candidates. The 1998 and thick-border 1999 sources are compared separately; the residual 1999 width difference does not establish identical historical printing. See docs/research/bc-modern-numerals/bordered-may.md.

1998-type-ii.finding: The exact MAY selection uses a source-supported M/A/Y reconstruction and AY spacing, with natural whole-run fitting. The lighter control and other month forms retain their existing role candidates.

No historical typeface or manufacturer identity is claimed. See docs/research/bc-modern-numerals/.
